summary.title: SSOT Registry Governance Browser Content
summary.description: Generated content for a browser that displays SSOT Registry's own governance and the downstream ADR/SPEC templates shipped by ssot-contracts, including merged YAML bodies for technical marketing reuse.

decisionDocuments.title: Canonical registry is a single JSON document
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: The only authored machine-readable source of truth is `.ssot/registry.json`.
decisionDocuments.decision: Adopt a single JSON document under `.ssot/registry.json` as the canonical registry.
decisionDocuments.consequences: All tooling and validators must read and write exclusively to this file to prevent split-brain conditions.

decisionDocuments.title: Features are the targetable units
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Features are the only targetable implementation units. There is no separate `targets[]` section.
decisionDocuments.decision: Use features as the atomic unit of planning, implementation, and verification.
decisionDocuments.consequences: No target scopes may be established outside of registered feature rows.

decisionDocuments.title: Issues are plannable work items
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Issues and tickets can be planned as current, next, future, explicit, backlog, or out-of-bounds, but they are not substitute targets for features.
decisionDocuments.decision: Map plannable issues to features to represent delivery status.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Verification and gating are evaluated against features, not individual ticket status.

decisionDocuments.title: Entity-centric registry with a derived graph export
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: The canonical registry remains entity-centric JSON with explicit references. Graph exports, lineage views, DOT, SVG, and HTML are derived projections from canonical registry truth.
decisionDocuments.decision: Graph projections shall distinguish canonical registry relationships from derived convenience relationships.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Orphan evidence, claims without supporting evidence, and compatibility mirror mismatches shall be visible as graph diagnostics.

decisionDocuments.title: Normalized prefixed IDs
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Every first-class entity uses a normalized prefixed ID.
decisionDocuments.decision: Enforce strict ID prefix constraints (e.g., adr:, spc:, clm:, evd:) across the entire schema.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Prevents collision and allows instant static analysis of node types.

decisionDocuments.title: Claim status and claim tier are orthogonal
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: The groupsum/ssot-registry repo's claim status expresses lifecycle progression. Claim tier expresses assurance strength.
decisionDocuments.decision: Discouple status from tier. Claim status tracks pipeline flow; claim tier tracks verification depth.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Allows evaluating high-status claims that are locked to low-assurance thresholds.

decisionDocuments.title: Feature implementation state is separate from lifecycle state
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: `implementation_status` and `lifecycle.stage` are distinct fields.
decisionDocuments.decision: Separately track whether code is physically written vs whether the capability is supported.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Features can be deprecating or obsolete while still retaining their implemented code on disk.

decisionDocuments.title: Immutable boundary and release snapshots
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Frozen boundaries and promoted/published releases emit immutable snapshots with hashes.
decisionDocuments.decision: Hash all linked entities, docs, and tests when locking a boundary or release.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Gives auditors a tamper-proof receipt that fails validation if any component drifts.

decisionDocuments.title: Fail-closed guards
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Validation, certification, promotion, publication, and lifecycle transitions refuse to proceed on guard violations.
decisionDocuments.decision: Abort any state mutations or pipeline progressions if a single validation check fails.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Guarantees that an invalid registry never reaches production or gets committed to git.

decisionDocuments.title: Generated projections are non-canonical
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: In the upstream `ssot-registry` repository, canonical governance documents are the `ssot-core` ADRs and specs authored under `.ssot/`.
decisionDocuments.decision: Do not treat generated reports, sitemaps, or graphs as the source of truth.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Projections may be safely overwritten or regenerated without losing history.

decisionDocuments.title: Explicit schema versioning
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Breaking schema changes increment `schema_version` and require migration.
decisionDocuments.decision: Lock schema versions and require migrations for any modifications to the JSON SOT layout.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Ensures backward compatibility and lets older clients reject newer registries safely.

decisionDocuments.title: Portable SSOT core with repo-specific evidence adapters
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: The SSOT core contract governs and validates the registry graph. Repository-specific evidence generation is implemented outside the core (or through adapters) per repository.
decisionDocuments.decision: Decouple core validation from local test runners.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Enables the core engine to validate proof links regardless of whether tests are run via pytest, vitest, or bash.

decisionDocuments.title: Enforce max path and filename lengths under `.ssot`
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Files under `.ssot` MUST respect these limits: Maximum relative path length: 240, Maximum filename length: 120.
decisionDocuments.decision: Enforce path length limits during validation.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Ensures full cross-platform compatibility across Windows, Linux, and macOS.

decisionDocuments.title: Profiles are reusable feature bundles with derived pass status
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: The registry needed an entity between atomic features and release boundaries.
decisionDocuments.decision: Introduce a first-class `profiles` entity that bundles features and nested profiles.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Enables reusable capability groupings and composite compliance reviews.

decisionDocuments.title: Monorepo package topology under `pkgs/`
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: All publishable packages SHALL live under `pkgs/`.
decisionDocuments.decision: Organize publishable packages in monorepo directories.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Improves project structure and dependency resolution.

decisionDocuments.title: Hybrid package versioning policy
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Python package versioning SHALL follow a hybrid model.
decisionDocuments.decision: Keep core library packages in lockstep versioning; allow CLI/TUI to version independently.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Developers can update user surfaces without publishing breaking database changes.

decisionDocuments.title: Govern migration paths as explicit schema edges
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Migration support SHALL be represented as explicit source-to-target schema edges.
decisionDocuments.decision: Define migrations as explicit directed edges with verification tests.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Ensures every historical version has a verified upgrade path to current schemas.

decisionDocuments.title: Assurance-language ceilings for feature target claim tiers
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Package maintainers need plain-language boundaries for what can be claimed about a feature at each target tier.
decisionDocuments.decision: Establish explicit language ceilings by tier (e.g. T0: Declared, T1: Verified, T2: Robust, T3: Certified, T4: Attested).
decisionDocuments.consequences: Eliminates marketing inflation and enforces absolute honesty in release notes.

decisionDocuments.title: Adopt RFC 8785 JCS for .ssot JSON artifacts
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: JSON serialization drift creates inconsistent file hashes across runtimes.
decisionDocuments.decision: Adopt RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) as the canonical JSON format for all .ssot artifacts.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Guarantees deterministic, reproducible cryptographic signatures across Node, Python, and Rust.

decisionDocuments.title: CLI list ids filtering
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Operators need to query specific entity subsets without reading the entire index output.
decisionDocuments.decision: Add a standard `--ids` filter to all CLI list commands.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Improves scriptability and integration with pipeline automation.

decisionDocuments.title: Automated registry status synchronization
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Manual status tracking of features, claims, tests, and evidence leads to validation lag.
decisionDocuments.decision: Introduce a standard `registry sync-statuses` command to derive states from proof graphs.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Provides an idempotent, automated way to finalize registry state before locking code freezes.

decisionDocuments.title: TUI registry loads run in background workers
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Reading and validating large registry JSON files inside the TUI can lock the main event thread and freeze user interactions.
decisionDocuments.decision: Implement non-blocking background workers using Python Textual's worker API for registry parsing and validation.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Ensures a highly responsive, stutter-free operator experience even on deep projects.

decisionDocuments.title: Repo-local TOML configuration
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Repositories need durable local policies for CLI defaults, automation settings, and workspace paths.
decisionDocuments.decision: Establish `.ssot/config.toml` as the authoritative, versionable, repo-local policy file.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Separates canonical project truth from local developer workspace preferences.

decisionDocuments.title: File and folder lock leases
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Concurrent processes or automated agents mutating the same workspace can corrupt the JSON database.
decisionDocuments.decision: Support lease-based folder/file locks to prevent overlapping writes.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Secures collaborative multi-worker execution chains on local nodes.

decisionDocuments.title: Registry JSON file locking is scoped separately
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Protecting `.ssot/registry.json` must be extremely robust and lightweight.
decisionDocuments.decision: Use a simple file-system sidecar lock (.lock file) to serialize direct database modifications.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Fails fast with clear concurrency errors without requiring a heavy lock manager database.

decisionDocuments.title: ssot-pack-contracts is the shared governance-pack contract layer
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Integrating third-party compliance standards (e.g. SOC2, HIPAA) required duplicating manifest logic.
decisionDocuments.decision: Introduce a lightweight shared contracts module `ssot-pack-contracts` for third-party compliance extension packs.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Standardizes metadata, resource loading, and sync rules across all community-contributed policy packs.

decisionDocuments.title: Pack-scoped document identity for extension packs
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Using bare ADR/SPEC identifiers like `adr:0001` leads to collision when loading SOC2 and HIPAA policy packs together.
decisionDocuments.decision: Scope extension-pack documents globally using tuples of `(pack_id, document_kind, local_id)`.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Enables loading any number of parallel compliance standards without id collision.

decisionDocuments.title: Downstream assurance-language ceilings for feature target claim tiers
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Downstream repositories must adopt the same high compliance standards and honest phrasing.
decisionDocuments.decision: Require all conforming downstream repositories to enforce target-tier assurance language ceilings in their reports.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Ensures that a release report cannot describe a T1 feature with T3 'certified' or T4 'attested' language.

decisionDocuments.title: Feature parent links are inventory composition
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Modeling leaf features and parent features must not create complex dependency loops.
decisionDocuments.decision: Declare parent links as inventory-grouping elements only; they do not affect readiness pass/fail logic.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Separates logical workspace layout from physical compilation blockers.

decisionDocuments.title: Public registry save validates before write
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: Direct Python API calls to save registry state could bypass validation rules, writing corrupt nodes.
decisionDocuments.decision: Force the public `save_registry` API to run schema validation and fail closed on errors.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Only explicit, checked-in recovery scripts can write unvalidated schemas.

decisionDocuments.title: Evidence Owns Proof Linkage
decisionDocuments.author: SSOT Core Team
decisionDocuments.context: The old schema linked claims directly to tests, creating ambiguous proof triangles without tracking the physical artifact.
decisionDocuments.decision: Declare evidence as the canonical proof carrier. The path is strictly: `test -> evidence -> claim`.
decisionDocuments.consequences: Tests do not prove claims directly; they produce evidence, and evidence supports claims with absolute provenance.

specificationDocuments.title: CLI metadata contract
specificationDocuments.ruleDefinition: CLI metadata must describe output formats, entity families, root flags, and support `--version` package version reporting.
specificationDocuments.description: Standardizes CLI execution parameters, exit codes, and output formatting flags.

specificationDocuments.title: TUI metadata contract
specificationDocuments.ruleDefinition: TUI must render entity sections, table columns, search filters, and CLI bridges matching CLI schemas.
specificationDocuments.description: Enforces visual parity and keybinding consistency across the Textual operator browser.

specificationDocuments.title: Migration path coverage contract
specificationDocuments.ruleDefinition: Every schema version change must register a pytest migration edge with explicit target coverage and test assertions.
specificationDocuments.description: Automates compatibility checking and prevents silent data loss during registry upgrades.

specificationDocuments.title: RFC 8785 JCS canonical JSON for .ssot artifacts
specificationDocuments.ruleDefinition: All registry JSON payloads must be parsed, stripped of formatting whitespace, sorted by keys, and serialized according to JCS standards.
specificationDocuments.description: Ensures that SHA256 digests remain perfectly stable across different programming language runtimes.

specificationDocuments.title: Automated status synchronization specifications
specificationDocuments.ruleDefinition: Status derivations must be derived idempotently from the proof graph without escalating claim tiers without tier-gate approvals.
specificationDocuments.description: Provides an auditable pre-closure pipeline before final boundary seals are established.

specificationDocuments.title: TUI non-blocking registry loading specification
specificationDocuments.ruleDefinition: TUI load worker calls must not run on the main thread; pending requests must show active loading state and older loads must be superseded.
specificationDocuments.description: Enforces complete responsiveness of the UI during heavy cryptographic hash computations.

specificationDocuments.title: TOML configuration contract specifications
specificationDocuments.ruleDefinition: CLI must read default command, path, and sync choices from .ssot/config.toml, applying explicit CLI flags as highest precedence.
specificationDocuments.description: Defines option resolution chains across the operator workspace.

specificationDocuments.title: File and folder locking specifications
specificationDocuments.ruleDefinition: Lease acquisitions must block overlapping directory changes; locks must carry expiration timers and hearts to recover from crashes.
specificationDocuments.description: Regulates concurrency and data safety in multi-process pipeline execution.

specificationDocuments.title: Registry JSON file locking specifications
specificationDocuments.ruleDefinition: A sidecar lock must be successfully acquired and verified before any direct write to .ssot/registry.json can proceed.
specificationDocuments.description: Provides thread-safe lock protection for the local database file.

specificationDocuments.title: ssot-pack-contracts package contract specifications
specificationDocuments.ruleDefinition: The module must publish PackMetadata, PackDocumentEntry, error definitions, and zero-dependency binding helpers for compliance packs.
specificationDocuments.description: Defines the integration surface for third-party compliance pack developers.

specificationDocuments.title: Extension-pack document materialization contract
specificationDocuments.ruleDefinition: Materialized rows from third-party packs must generate unique, pack-prefixed IDs (spc:pack.<pack>.<id>) and normalize source provenance.
specificationDocuments.description: Guarantees namespace safety when running SOC2 and HIPAA controls in the same registry.

specificationDocuments.title: Downstream assurance-language ceilings specifications
specificationDocuments.ruleDefinition: Verification reports must reject release claims if their plain-language descriptions exceed their effective claim tier limits.
specificationDocuments.description: Mandates clean, honest vocabulary in developer docs and release logs.

specificationDocuments.title: Feature parent link contract specifications
specificationDocuments.ruleDefinition: Parent link parameters on child features are only allowed for organization and must not affect prerequisite gating.
specificationDocuments.description: Prevents logical loops and ensures parent links are reserved strictly for index categorization.

specificationDocuments.title: Registry save validation contract specifications
specificationDocuments.ruleDefinition: Default save APIs must validate candidate registries under complete schema checkers and fail closed on all errors.
specificationDocuments.description: Secures programmatic save calls from generating invalid database states.

specificationDocuments.title: Evidence Centered Proof Link Contract specifications
specificationDocuments.ruleDefinition: Evidence rows must directly own target claim_ids and producer test_ids. Direct test-to-claim links are deprecated and ignored for proof.
specificationDocuments.description: Centrally binds cryptographic evidence as the absolute source of validation proof.
